description.value:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.The Crossing] at 14th level.

The Twin Swords crossed in this creature, and the wound will not close. It receives only half the Hit Points from any healing while it is bleeding from The Crossing.

Automation note: pf2e has no modifier that multiplies healing, so the halving is applied to the Hit Points that actually landed, and said out loud in chat each time.
